# Project instructions

Read PROMPT.md, docs/DESIGN.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/STATUS.md before work.

## Active scope (owner correction, 2026-10-12)

- Track **Lavazza Crema e Gusto vacuum-packed ground coffee only**. Qualità Oro, Qualità Rossa, Suerte
  and every other Lavazza product line are retired: they must not be vendored, fetched, culled or shown
  in the shopping UI. Adding another product line requires an explicit new owner instruction.
- Keep Crema e Gusto pack sizes/multipacks as distinct offers, but there is **no blend/variant feature**
  (owner correction, 2026-10-12): every eligible Crema e Gusto vacuum-packed ground listing — including
  a listing that states no blend wording — takes part in one comparison for the selected quantity,
  locality and delivery method. Do not add a blend selector, unobserved-variant menu entries, variant
  warnings, "other variant" counts/links or variant-specific product cards. Raw vendor listing wording
  and any stated blend wording may stay as evidence inside optional offer details, never as a filter or
  a repeated badge, and an unstated listing must never be relabelled as Classico. Old shared URLs with
  an obsolete `variant=` parameter keep their product/quantity/locality and resolve to this unified
  comparison.
- The production Worker name is `attention-shoppers` and must match `wrangler.jsonc`. The owner reports
  the site deployed at https://attention-shoppers.igormaka.workers.dev; on 2026-10-12 the loop independently
  verified the public URL, one request-triggered refresh and the single-product scope with read-only GETs
  (docs/evidence/production-verification-20261012T1554Z.json, docs/evidence/production-probe-20261012T1653Z.json).
  Re-check production read-only with `npm run probe:production` (fixed public GETs, no credentials, no
  deploy). Keep owner reports and verified evidence distinct in docs/STATUS.md, and never administer or
  deploy Cloudflare.
- Improve only Crema e Gusto vendor coverage, shipping evidence, freshness and comparison quality.

- Work directly on main, as authorized by the owner. Keep each checkpoint useful and testable. Do not change Shurik's control branch or engine.
- No direct Cloudflare administration: no CF API calls, deploy commands, login, token discovery, or remote resource creation. Local Wrangler dev and deploy --dry-run are allowed. The owner alone connects Cloudflare Workers Builds.
- Never request or publish secrets, addresses, sessions or customer checkout details. OPENCODE_API_KEY and the GitHub token stay in the runner environment.
- Never invent stock, product identity, prices, shipping, delivery times or successful refreshes. Publish evidence and timestamps; preserve unknowns and previous good data on errors.
- Colors must convey status or meaning. No emoji in the website typography. Use labels and monochrome vector wayfinding symbols.
- Run npm run verify before completing each change. Keep dependencies pinned and package-lock.json current.
- Finish each iteration by updating docs/STATUS.md with completed work, test results, next task and any blocking evidence.
- Mark the site ready for the owner's Cloudflare handoff only when the acceptance checks in PROMPT.md pass. Do not deploy it yourself.
=====STATUS=====
- `src/lib/quote.js` exports `offerIdentity()`/`dedupeObservations()` and applies them to the candidate
  rows of every board: rows for the same vendor + listing URL collapse to the most recently observed
  one. Distinct listings, pack sizes and multipacks keep distinct URLs/SKUs and stay separate offers.
  The legacy blend-keyed row in an old persisted store is therefore invisible as a duplicate, with no
  destructive migration and no change to its price, stock or observation time.
- `src/refresh.js` resolves a failed attempt's marker to the newest row for the listing URL (so a failure
  warning cannot land on a hidden legacy row) and falls back to the newest same-URL row for the
  previous-check comparison, so the key change keeps one step of price/stock evidence instead of losing
  it once.

**Verified locally (2026-10-13 UTC):**

- `npm run verify` — **153/153** `node:test` cases pass (3 new: the key is identical for stated and
  unstated blend wording, two rows of one listing URL collapse to the newest offer, and a seeded legacy
  row plus its stable-key replacement keep the previous price and the failure marker on the visible
  row); `wrangler deploy --dry-run` builds the bundle (120.39 KiB, gzip 30.04 KiB; bindings `BOARD` +
  `ASSETS`).
- `npm run qa:browser` (offline fixtures) — **89/89** checks, zero console errors; the home→product
  navigation, unified comparison with Coffee4U, disclosures, quantity/destination changes, named vendors,
  honest unknowns and mobile first-viewport money values all still pass, and a new rendered check proves
  one card per vendor listing URL while the fixture store deliberately holds a legacy blend-keyed Pucks
  row next to its stable-key twin. Evidence:
  `docs/evidence/browser-qa-fixtures-20261013T0058Z.json`.
- Fresh-store `wrangler dev` initial refresh (00:48:48.742Z → 00:49:06.784Z, live vendor fetches, no
  browser opened for the refresh): all three vendors succeeded, five observations stored, and the keys
  are now stable (`pucks:Lav69:ground:250g:x1`, `coffeeman:930333:ground:250g:x1`, …). The board ranks
  Pucks ₪90, CoffeeMan ₪91, Coffee4U ₪106, CoffeeMan 4-pack ₪149 and 8-pack ₪260; the obsolete
  `?variant=unspecified` request returns the identical ranking and there are four separate pickup rows.
- **Old-store case exercised end-to-end:** a legacy blend-keyed row
  (`pucks:Lav69:classico:ground:250g:x1`, price ₪29, observed 2026-10-12T18:00Z) was seeded next to the
  stable-key Pucks row in the local Durable Object store. The store then held 6 rows; `/api/board`
  returned **5 ranked offers** (no duplicate Pucks offer), the Pucks offer kept the newest observation
  (₪30, stable key), and the pickup list stayed at 4 rows. Evidence:
  `docs/evidence/local-old-store-dedupe-20261013T0052Z.json`.
- `npm run qa:browser -- http://127.0.0.1:8789` against that Worker (legacy row present) — **84/84**
  checks with zero console errors (the same run after the new duplicate check was added to the harness
  passed **85/85** against the clean local store). Evidence:
  `docs/evidence/browser-qa-live-20261013T0050Z.json`, `docs/evidence/browser-qa-live-20261013T0055Z.json`.
- `scripts/qa-server.mjs` now seeds the QA-only legacy blend-keyed row in the fixture store, and
  `tests/qa-server.test.js` asserts the six stored rows collapse to five ranked offers with distinct
  listing URLs; `scripts/browser-qa.mjs` adds the rendered one-card-per-listing-URL check.
- `npm run cron:offline` — 6 bounded requests, all three vendors saved (five offers), no failures, FX
  fixture stored; the repeatable local cron simulation still works with the identity change.
- `npm run check:sources` (live, 00:55 UTC) — all five listings pass with unchanged prices and stock
  (CoffeeMan ₪33/₪124/₪240, Pucks ₪30, Coffee4U ₪38, all `in_stock`) and the recorded rates and coverage
  caveats. This is the runner-side independent check; the CoffeeMan Worker-egress block remains a
  production-specific condition. Evidence: `docs/evidence/source-check-20261013T0055Z.json`.
- `npm run probe:production` (read-only public GETs, 00:56 UTC) — **25/25** checks against
  `https://attention-shoppers.igormaka.workers.dev`: the 00:18 store still serves five ranked offers
  under the pre-change keys (the read-time collapse matters only once the next refresh writes
  stable-key rows), the obsolete `?variant=` request returns the identical unified board, no retired
  row appears, and all four shipping policies plus the promotion are current. CoffeeMan's next attempt
  is the 06:17 UTC tick. Evidence: `docs/evidence/production-probe-20261013T0056Z.json`.
- Defensive hardening: an unparseable observation time never outranks a real one in the read-time
  collapse, the failure-marker target or the previous-check fallback; the dedupe test asserts it.
- Visual record: `docs/evidence/visual-review/2026-10-13-identity-change-review.json` with sanitized
  fixture screenshots of the home index and product page at 1440 px and 390 px plus the failed-attempt
  state. The rendered UI was not restyled by this data-layer change. The file-read tool still rejects
  PNG input, so no image-based claim is made; labels and arithmetic are corroborated by the DOM/API
  assertions of the same 89/89 QA session.
- Docs: `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` documents the offer identity and the read-time collapse;
  `docs/STATUS.md`'s current-state section now states precisely that only the board-level
  `variantId`/`excludedByVariant` fields are gone while per-offer `product.variantId`/`variantLabel`
  remain raw listing identity metadata in optional offer details.

**Production note:** the change is backwards compatible with the deployed store. The current five
production rows are legacy blend-keyed and unique, so they render unchanged; after the next successful
refresh writes stable-key rows, the read-time collapse keeps the board at five offers while the old rows
remain harmless. No destructive migration and no Cloudflare administration were used.

**Next step:** re-run `npm run probe:production` after the **06:17 UTC tick** (the next scheduled attempt
for all three vendors) to record whether the CoffeeMan egress block persists and whether the refreshed
rows parse; the served assets can also be checked for the new identity code after the main-push build
deploys. Then continue within Crema e Gusto coverage, shipping evidence, freshness and comparison quality.

## Iteration 3-82 — CoffeeMan's observed free condition applied at its scope; the 2 kg comparison matches the vendor's own cart (2026-10-13)

**The gap.** The CoffeeMan anonymous-cart research on 2026-10-12 (19:56-20:09 UTC) had already recorded
that home courier was charged ₪25 on the ₪66/₪124/₪132/₪198 carts but **free** from the ₪231
(7 × 250 g) cart, on the ₪264 (₪237.60 after the automatic 10% promotion) 8 × 250 g cart and on the
₪248 two-4-pack cart. The board stored that as a note only and kept the published ₪25 everywhere, so at
2 kg it showed the CoffeeMan 8-singles offer at ₪237.60 + ₪25 = **₪262.60** and called Pucks ₪240 the
best — even though the vendor's own anonymous cart showed that exact offer at **₪237.60 delivered**. That
is the owner's "store conditional evidence at its actual scope" case, not a rule the board should infer
globally: the ₪240 8-pack SKU cart kept its own ₪20 quote.

**What changed (implementation).**

- `coffeeman-single-4pack-il-home-delivery` is now **v2**: the published ₪25 base rate stays, and the
  policy carries `freeThreshold: ₪231`, `thresholdSemantics: 'at_least'`, `freeThresholdOrigin:
  'observed_cart'` and its own `freeThresholdEvidence` (anonymous checkout, 2026-10-12T20:09:00Z).
  ₪231 is the **lowest observed free subtotal** — the ₪198 cart was charged ₪25 — so the engine can only
  under-promise free delivery below it, never invent it. The ₪240 8-pack SKU has a separate policy with
  its own ₪20 quote and no free threshold.
- The policy validator rejects an unknown threshold origin, an origin without a threshold, and an
  `observed_cart` threshold without evidence; `ruleKey` now includes the threshold semantics/origin so
  two conflicting policies still resolve as `inconsistent`.
- Read-time enrichment copies the threshold, semantics, origin and evidence to an old persisted row
  (price, stock and `observedAt` untouched), and the CoffeeMan adapter stamps the same fields on freshly
  parsed single/4-pack rows while the policy is current. When `reviewBy` passes, the free condition is
  withheld with the policy and the offer falls back to the published ₪25.
- The quote engine exposes `shipping.freeThresholdOrigin`/`freeThresholdEvidence` and labels the met
  condition `Free shipping threshold met (from ₪231.00, observed in the vendor's anonymous cart)`. The
  product page renders `Free (threshold met)` + `Home delivery` + `Published rate (verified) · free
  condition cart-observed`, a card-face qualifier ("Free delivery applied from an anonymous-cart
  observation; confirm it at checkout.") and the full provenance in `Delivery options` and `Offer
  details`.

**Verified locally (2026-10-13 UTC):**

- `npm run verify` — **155/155** `node:test` cases pass (up from 153; new coverage: the policy shape and
  origin/evidence validation, the old persisted single row gaining the free condition at read time, the
  ₪231 boundary free and the ₪198 cart still charged, the two-4-pack ₪248 cart free, the 8-pack SKU
  keeping ₪20 with no threshold, the expired-policy path withholding the free condition, and the
  conditional label helpers). `wrangler deploy --dry-run` builds the bundle (124.78 KiB / gzip
  30.93 KiB; bindings `BOARD` + `ASSETS`).
- `npm run check:sources` (live, 01:22 UTC) — all five listings pass with unchanged prices and stock;
  the parsed CoffeeMan rows carry the new threshold fields and the updated cart note.
- Fresh-store `wrangler dev` initial refresh (01:24:05.165Z → 01:24:23.281Z, live vendor fetches, no
  browser opened for the refresh): **6 bounded requests**, all three vendors saved, five observations.
  The 2 kg board ranks **CoffeeMan 8 × 250 g singles ₪237.60** (10% promotion → ₪237.60 item, free
  observed threshold, ₪118.80/kg), Pucks ₪240.00 (free above ₪100), CoffeeMan 2 × 4-pack ₪248.00 (free
  observed threshold), CoffeeMan 8-pack ₪260.00 (its own ₪20 quote) and Coffee4U ₪334.00. At 250 g/500 g
  the ranking is unchanged (CoffeeMan ₪58, Pucks ₪90). Evidence:
  `docs/evidence/worker-runtime-status-2026-10-13T0124Z.json`.
- **Every observed anonymous-cart courier amount is reproduced by the engine**
  (`docs/evidence/coffeeman-free-condition-20261013.json`): ₪66→₪25, ₪124→₪25, ₪132→₪25, ₪198→₪25,
  ₪231→free, ₪264/₪237.60→free, ₪248 (2 × 4-pack)→free, ₪240 (8-pack SKU)→₪20. The 8-pack SKU never
  inherits the free condition.
- `npm run qa:browser` (offline fixtures) — **90/90** checks, zero console errors; the 2 kg fixture now
  asserts the observed-free card face (Free + cart-observed certainty + qualifier + conditions text),
  the 8-pack's own ₪20 quote and the undiscounted multipacks. `npm run qa:browser --
  http://127.0.0.1:8789` against the fresh live Worker — **86/86**, zero console errors. Evidence:
  `docs/evidence/browser-qa-fixtures-20261013T0131Z.json`,
  `docs/evidence/browser-qa-live-20261013T0124Z.json`.
- Visual record: `docs/evidence/visual-review/2026-10-13-coffeeman-free-condition-review.json` with
  sanitized home/product screenshots at 1440 px and 390 px and the coarse pixel map of the 2 kg board.
  The file-read tool still rejects PNG input, so no image-based claim is made; labels and arithmetic are
  corroborated by the rendered DOM text and the API in the same session.

**Production note:** the change is backwards compatible. The deployed store's old CoffeeMan single/4-pack
rows gain the observed free condition at read time (no vendor refresh, no `lastRefreshAt` change), so
the 2 kg best becomes ₪237.60 as soon as this build is live. The 06:17 UTC cron tick remains the next
actual vendor attempt (and the next CoffeeMan egress retry); no Cloudflare administration was used.

**Next step:** re-run `npm run probe:production` after the main-push build deploys to confirm the old
persisted CoffeeMan rows gained the free condition at read time (`ranked=5`, 2 kg best CoffeeMan
₪237.60, policy v2) and after the **06:17 UTC tick** to record whether the CoffeeMan egress block
persists; then continue within Crema e Gusto coverage, shipping evidence, freshness and comparison
quality.

as tombstones in `src/catalog.js` (so old links and historical pages are refused with an explicit reason)
and as historical evidence in docs/SOURCES.md and `tests/fixtures/historical-retired/`. Re-adding any
product line requires an explicit new owner instruction.

## What the Worker does now

- **One-product comparison board** (`/`, `/api/board`): ranks delivered offers for Lavazza Crema e Gusto
  ground coffee in a vacuum brick by item price + shipping + mandatory fees in ILS, normalized to
  delivered ILS/kg and to the packs a shopper actually buys. Destination (six Israeli locality/postcode
  areas, including "Elsewhere in Israel") and target grams are selectable; no street
  address is collected or stored. `/api/catalog` exposes exactly one product, no variant menu, and the
  three vendor adapters.
- **No blend/variant feature (owner correction, 2026-10-12)**: every eligible Crema e Gusto ground
  listing is compared together. The Coffee4U listing, which states no blend wording, is included rather
  than hidden behind a selector; a listing that prints Classico/Forte wording keeps that wording only as
  raw listing identity metadata (`product.variantId`/`variantLabel` on the offer, shown only inside its
  optional offer details) and never as a filter, menu, warning or badge. `quoteBoard()` has no variant
  filter or exclusion count, `?variant=` is ignored by the Worker and the offline harness, and old shared
  URLs keep product/quantity/locality while the product page strips the obsolete parameter from the
  address bar. A stored offer's identity key is vendor + SKU/product + form + pack size, not the blend
  wording, and rows for one listing URL are collapsed at read time (newest observation wins), so a
  wording change cannot duplicate one SKU. Single 250 g, 4 × 250 g and 8 × 250 g offers are never merged.
- **Retired lines cannot reappear**: `classifyListing()` rejects a retired listing with a reason naming
  the retired line; `resolveProductRequest()` maps an old `?product=lavazza-qualita-oro-vacuum-ground`
  (or Rossa/Suerte) URL back to the tracked product and returns `requestedRetiredProduct` so the board
  can explain the fallback; `pruneRetiredObservations()` deletes any stored retired observation or
  attempt marker on every refresh. The UI shows the tracked product as a static label (no dead
  one-option picker) and displays a written retired-line notice when a query URL asked for one.

`src/lib/policies.js` is the shared, versioned shipping-evidence model. A policy states the vendor,
product/SKU scope, service, destination scope, the amount or free-shipping threshold rule (with the
vendor's `above`/`at_least` wording preserved), the evidence URL and retrieval time, and a `reviewBy`
date. `quoteBoard()` applies the evaluator at read time: an observation whose own shipping is unknown
is enriched with a matching validated policy, while an observation that already carries a fresher
amount, threshold or destination is never overwritten. The evaluator is deterministic and refuses to
guess: conflicting policies for the same scope stay `inconsistent`, a malformed policy is `invalid`,
and a policy past its review date is `expired`, so the offer falls back to explicit unknown shipping
instead of a stale unconditional rate. Enrichment never touches the observation's price, stock,
`observedAt` or the refresh completion marker, so applying a newer shipping rule cannot claim a fresh
vendor price/stock check; `policySummary()` exposes the rule version, observation time and review date
through `/api/status`. Four validated policies are checked in: Pucks' ₪30/free-above-₪100 home-delivery
rule, CoffeeMan's published ₪25 single/4-pack rule with its cart-observed ₪15 distribution-center
alternative and the cart-observed free condition (free home courier from the lowest observed free ₪231
item subtotal; a ₪198 cart was charged ₪25, so the condition is stored at that observed scope with its
own `observed_cart` origin and evidence and is never presented as a published threshold), CoffeeMan's
₪20 checkout quote for the one-8-pack (2 kg) cart (which carries `maxTotalGrams: 2000` so the quote
engine never stretches it to an unobserved larger cart and records no free threshold for this SKU), and
Coffee4U's published ₪30 door-to-door rule with its ₪15 pickup-point alternative and the observed
closed-locality-list coverage shape. Secondary delivery
methods are part of the policy representation: the evaluator adds them only when a stored row has
none, and they never replace the ranked amount. Each policy is also the adapter's single source for
the researched values it describes, so the parsed row, the read-time evaluator and the tests share one
representation instead of separate hard-coded strings. The adapters honor the same `reviewBy` gate at
parse time (`policyIsCurrent()`): once a policy is past its review date, its researched rate and any
policy-derived alternative are withheld, so a freshly parsed offer falls back to explicit unknown
shipping rather than carrying a stale quote forward. Page-published rates (CoffeeMan's ₪25 and
Coffee4U's ₪30/₪15) are parsed from the vendor page and stay independent of the policy window.

Option A: if the board quote's policy stamp version is older than the status version AND the rules are identical, then it's a bug (the read-time refresh should have updated it). Option C: assert the best offer's policy `observedAt` matches the status `observedAt` when versions are equal; and when the version is older, assert the note explains. Too complex.

Option D (simplest, still useful): assert that every ranked offer's applied policy id/version appears in the status policy list (well-formedness), and that the **best offer's policy version is not older than the status version when the shipping amount/threshold/service match the current policy's summary** (comparable fields available in the status summary). # Attention shoppers. Happy hunting.

## Latest owner correction — remove the coffee-variant feature (2026-10-12)

The owner explicitly asks: "Get rid of the coffee variant. There's only two variants and it's the same coffee." Treat the tracked Crema e Gusto listings as **one coffee comparison**, not separate shopper-selectable blends. This latest instruction supersedes every older variant-separation/selector requirement in this prompt, AGENTS.md and the design/architecture/status documentation. Implement it first in the next fresh iteration, then continue the product index, progressive disclosure and shipping-policy work below.

- Remove the blend/variant selector, unobserved-variant menu entries, variant warnings, "other variant" counts/links and variant-as-a-shopping-configuration from the home and product page. Do not replace it with another blend toggle or add variant-specific product cards.
- Compare all eligible tracked Crema e Gusto vacuum-packed ground offers together for the selected quantity, locality and delivery method. Include the currently "Variant not stated" Coffee4U listing in that same comparison instead of hiding it behind a selector or withholding it as another blend. Offers can still be unavailable/unrankable for genuine stock, freshness, shipping or cart-scope reasons.
- Keep single packs, four-packs and eight-packs as distinct offers with correct whole-pack rounding, purchased grams, item prices, shipping conditions and totals. Removing the variant feature does not merge or duplicate SKUs, pack sizes, cart discounts or service-specific policies.
- Retain original vendor product wording and any raw listing identity metadata in evidence/optional offer details if useful. Do not invent a manufacturer blend or relabel an unstated listing as Classico to make it eligible. Raw wording is provenance, not a default ranking filter or repeated variant badge.
- Remove implicit variant filtering from the default API/quote flow, not just its visible widget. Old shared URLs containing variant=classico/unspecified/etc must still preserve product/quantity/locality but resolve to this unified comparison; discard or ignore the obsolete variant parameter without creating a second view.
- Update AGENTS.md, catalog/public API where appropriate, docs and browser QA so they no longer instruct variant separation. Verify that the single product comparison can include Coffee4U alongside the other Crema e Gusto listings, still names vendors correctly, calculates packs/shipping honestly and has no residual blend control/warning. Existing stock, policy-scope, unknown-shipping and retired-product safeguards remain mandatory.

The active catalog remains Lavazza Crema e Gusto vacuum-packed ground coffee only; Oro, Rossa, Suerte and other product lines stay excluded. The home is still the product index with one real card. Keep the Canton Zürich design system, Inter and established semantic palette. Shurik writes the code/tests; the overseer only steers and reviews.

## Current owner priorities — product index, reusable shipping knowledge, progressive disclosure (2026-10-12)

The owner has reviewed the updated website and still finds it very cluttered. The home page must become an overview index of products, with the comparison workflow on a dedicated product page. The owner also expects obvious browser-visible shipping rules, such as Pucks free shipping above ₪100, to be found systematically and actually used by the site. These priorities replace the earlier instruction to repeat the initial shipping investigation first in every fresh iteration. The first Pucks/CoffeeMan/Coffee4U browser investigation is already evidenced in iterations 3-67 through 3-72. Use that evidence; fresh browser work should address a specific missing, contradictory or stale condition. Do not spend whole iterations reproducing unchanged amounts while the requested product/UI work waits.

Shurik implements all code, assets, tests and documentation. The overseer only changes this brief and reviews results. Keep the Canton Zürich design direction, Inter, palette and Crema e Gusto-only active scope below.

### 1. Make the home page a product overview index

- The canonical home route must show a clean product index, not the full vendor comparison board. Render its cards from the active catalog. Today that means **one real card: Lavazza Crema e Gusto vacuum-packed ground coffee**. Design the structure to support additional products later, but do not add or reactivate Oro, Rossa, Suerte, other product lines, fabricated offerings or placeholder cards. Crema e Gusto offers share one comparison; pack sizes and multipacks remain distinct.
- Each product card links to a real, directly loadable product-detail URL. The home page needs only product identity, a concise useful summary and a clear way to open the comparison. If a summary price is shown, its quantity, destination, freshness and conditional nature must be understandable; do not mix different cart sizes into a misleading "from" price.
- The product page identifies the coffee and provides the quantity/locality/delivery controls and offers. Provide a clear "All products" way back. Preserve shareable selection state and handle existing product/query links, including retired-line fallbacks, without losing quantity or locality; obsolete variant parameters are ignored. Keep existing read-only APIs and deterministic refresh behavior working.
- The home title is "Attention shoppers" without a period. The product-detail heading should name the product, e.g. "Lavazza Crema e Gusto", with compact site branding. Do not reproduce a giant branding hero or comparison explanation on both pages.

### 2. Generalize browser shipping research and deterministic shipping policies

- Reuse the real Chrome/ChromeDriver helper, but build a reusable research workflow with vendor-specific navigation recipes and a common evidence output. It must navigate the product/cart/estimator, select the actual delivery method, set whole-pack quantities and permitted locality/postcode, wait for recalculation, and compare displayed item subtotal, shipping and final total. A subtotal displayed before choosing a method is not a delivered quote: the Pucks cart only adds its ₪30 after the delivery card is selected.
- Research a meaningful cart matrix per SKU/pack/service/destination: normal quantities plus below/above a displayed free-shipping threshold. Capture the threshold language, exclusions, minimum order, fees, delivery methods, locality restrictions, any discount and the exact blocker if a quote requires personal details. Keep the anonymous-cart/locality permission and the no-order/payment/login/account/street-address/bot-bypass restrictions below. Sanitize all URLs and output so cart/session/cookie/token values never enter public records.
- Introduce a common, validated shipping-evidence/policy representation and evaluator used by every adapter/quote: distinguish published rules, observed conditional cart quotes and unknown/inconsistent rules. Preserve service, eligible product/SKU/pack, quantity or weight/subtotal scope, destination scope, currency, amount or threshold rule, source, observed/review time and certainty. Per-vendor recipes may differ; common policy interpretation, arithmetic, evidence storage and validation should be shared. Do not keep accumulating unrelated hard-coded adapter strings as the only shipping model.
- Pucks is the concrete acceptance case: the rendered estimator established **₪30 home delivery and free shipping above the stated ₪100 item subtotal**, including 2 × 250 g = ₪60 + ₪30 = ₪90 and 4 × 250 g = ₪120 with free delivery to Tel Aviv / 6100000. Apply the rule to eligible current offers and show the free-shipping condition in the appropriate delivery details. Preserve the threshold comparison/exclusions actually established by the vendor; do not silently turn "above" into "at least" without checking the boundary semantics. Coverage remains qualified beyond the destinations tested.
- CoffeeMan demonstrates why a single global threshold is insufficient: the ₪240 eight-pack cart still charged ₪20 while some single-pack/two-four-pack carts showed free shipping; the small single/four-pack carts showed a ₪15 distribution-center alternative. Store conditional evidence at its actual scope, and keep unverified rules unresolved. Do not infer a nationwide/free-over-X rule from one cart or flatten SKU/pack distinctions. Scoped discounts and alternatives must not silently change the ranked courier amount beyond their verified applicability.
- **Fix the known-knowledge/old-store gap.** The latest recorded production probes still had old shipping unknowns even after the policies were established and deployed. Implement a safe versioned policy resolution/enrichment or migration so newly validated shipping knowledge can apply to matching persisted offers promptly, without waiting hours for the next item refresh. Choose the mechanism within the existing Worker architecture; keep it deterministic, bounded and compatible with stored data. Preserve the item's actual price/stock observation time and shipping evidence's own time; applying a newer shipping rule must not claim a fresh vendor price/stock check or advance lastRefreshAt. Do not fabricate an item price, force a Cloudflare refresh through admin tools, or turn a policy into an unconditional coverage guarantee. Test an old persisted Pucks offer with unknown shipping gaining the evidenced rule after a policy update.
- The public Worker must continue to work without the coding loop or a browser open. It should consume validated policy data and bounded public sources; browser research is development/research tooling, not an LLM/browser session triggered by visitor traffic. Document how policy evidence is rechecked or becomes stale, and keep unresolved shipping explicit.

### 3. Use substantial progressive disclosure on the product page

The goal is a short decision flow, not merely smaller versions of every existing paragraph.

- Default view: compact product identity/selection, an easy quantity and locality change, and the best eligible offer with vendor, accurate purchased pack/grams, item subtotal, **named delivery method and charge**, delivered total, stock and a short necessary conditional/unknown/stale warning. On 390 × 844, the actual money values and method must be visible in the initial viewport; a card whose top edge begins at y=829 does not satisfy this. Achieve this by prioritizing content, not tiny text or hiding essential uncertainty.
- Use a clear "Compare other offers" disclosure or a compact comparison preview. The Coffee4U listing belongs in the same Crema e Gusto comparison; retain its original vendor wording in evidence without a separate blend choice. Keep relevant controls accessible, with secondary configuration in a clearly labelled section/drawer when useful.
- Delivery alternatives, pickup locations/fees, free-shipping conditions, detailed coverage and terms belong under "Delivery options" / "Offer details". Self-pickup stays separate from delivered ranking and should be collapsed by default rather than three always-expanded repeated rows. Show a brief coverage qualification beside a conditional total, with the full prose inside details.
- Price history, parser/source provenance, FX, refresh diagnostics and detailed timestamps are secondary disclosures. Retain concise visible stale/failure/unknown warnings when they change a shopping decision. Hide empty "missing information" sections and remove repeated teaching copy, duplicate headings, repeated product restrictions and the same caveat printed several times.
- Use the Canton Zürich native disclosure/accordion/service patterns and the selected blue/soft-blue scheme. Keep semantic stock/uncertainty colors and text labels, keyboard/focus behavior, RTL handling and readable type. Opening one useful detail must not require reading through unrelated diagnostics.
- Fix the independently observed pickup-name regression: the saved after-1440/after-390 screenshots and passing QA output contained **"[object HTMLSpanElement]"** instead of the vendor. Current renderPickupSection passes bidi(quote.vendor.name), a DOM node, as an el() text attribute. Shurik fixes the node/text handling and adds a meaningful rendered check for the actual vendor names and the absence of object-string artifacts.
- The current shippingServiceText() returns a certainty label rather than a delivery-method name. Render the actual method (home courier / distribution-center or pickup-point delivery / self-pickup) separately from certainty, so a shopper can tell what the charge buys.

### Acceptance for this owner correction

Checkpoint useful progress, then complete all three outcomes: real home index + reachable product page, reusable shipping research/policy resolution with the Pucks old-store case, and progressive disclosure that exposes the core decision values on the first mobile screen. Update browser QA to exercise the home-to-product navigation, directly loaded/shareable product URLs, opening/closing disclosures, method/quantity/destination changes, named vendors, honest unknowns and the money values' actual visibility. Preserve catalog exclusions, pack arithmetic, conditional coverage, scheduled refresh/backoff and last-known-good storage.

Run npm run verify and relevant offline/local-live browser QA after changes; inspect readable desktop/mobile viewport screenshots of both pages when image tools support them. The current pi-durable read tool rejects images: report that limitation accurately; character/pixel maps are only coarse evidence and cannot establish that text is correct. Save sanitized screenshots for overseer review and corroborate labels/arithmetic with DOM/API evidence. Keep docs/DESIGN.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/SOURCES.md and docs/STATUS.md aligned with the final implementation. Do not let waiting for a future production cron tick replace this work, and do not claim the correction is live solely because code or a policy was committed.

## Owner design direction — Canton Zürich design system (2026-10-12)

Use **the Canton Zürich design system specifically** for the shopping-page redesign. This owner direction supersedes the earlier generic Swiss transport-signage reference in this prompt and docs/DESIGN.md. Use its web-application/service patterns to make a compact shopping tool, with consistent alignment, responsive grids, flat surfaces, clear type hierarchy and concise disclosures. Keep the product identity our own; no cantonal crest, government wordmark or implied affiliation.

Read the official primary references before implementing:
- Design system: https://www.zh.ch/de/webangebote-entwickeln-und-gestalten.html
- Colors: https://www.zh.ch/de/webangebote-entwickeln-und-gestalten/inhalt/designsystem/design-grundlagen/farben.html
- Typography: https://www.zh.ch/de/webangebote-entwickeln-und-gestalten/inhalt/designsystem/design-grundlagen/typografie.html
- Layout/grid: https://www.zh.ch/de/webangebote-entwickeln-und-gestalten/inhalt/designsystem/design-grundlagen/layout-und-raster.html

Chosen highlight scheme:
- **Blue theme:** official Blau `#0070B4`, paired with Softblau `#EDF5FA`. Use this sparingly for the selected shopping context and the clearly labelled best known delivered offer, with a blue rule or soft-blue panel. Do not paint arbitrary vendor names different colors or use green to mean cheapest.
- **Neutral structure:** white, black `#000000`, secondary text `#666666`, subtle surfaces `#F7F7F7` and dividers `#CCCCCC`. Follow the system's grey/black buttons and links; links must remain identifiable. Avoid decorative multicolor badges.
- **Stock:** official green `#1A7F1F` with `#EBF6EB` for verified in-stock labels; official red `#D93C1A` on white for unavailable/error labels.
- **Uncertainty:** amber text `#8A4B00` on `#FFF4E5` for unknown shipping, unconfirmed coverage and stale evidence. These amber tokens are our deliberate shopping-specific extension, not official Canton Zürich tokens; they preserve the owner's existing uncertainty semantics.
- Official Cyan `#009EE0` can mark active controls as a non-text indicator. It is not suitable for small text on white; use `#0070B4` for a consistently visible focus outline instead. Always retain written status labels and a distinct selected state.

Use **Inter**, explicitly supported by the official web-app typography guidance, with its recommended font features `ss07`, `ss08`, `cv03`, `cv04`, `cv10`; use a neutral system fallback and tabular numerals for prices. If adding a font, use an openly licensed self-hosted asset. Keep headings left aligned and compact: the home title must read "Attention shoppers" without a trailing period; the dedicated product page names the product and keeps the offer decision values near the top.

Update docs/DESIGN.md to this concrete design direction as part of your implementation. This is a usability redesign, not just recoloring: retain the shipping/subtotal/delivered-total grouping and mobile reflow requirements below. Reduce the oversized hero and repeated explanatory copy. Keep stock, quantity and destination controls useful and visible.

Unknown charges must say "Shipping not published" and explain what is needed; never substitute zero. A published rate with unconfirmed destination coverage must not be presented as guaranteed delivery or a fully confirmed checkout total. Use one Crema e Gusto ranking that includes Coffee4U and its published shipping methods; preserve its raw vendor identity without a blend filter.

Use that browser beyond predetermined QA assertions: navigate the existing vendors' product, shipping/terms and public cart/estimator pages; allow JavaScript to render; inspect delivery controls and publicly displayed rates for the relevant quantity and Israeli locality/postcode. A temporary anonymous cart containing the target coffee is permitted solely to inspect a public shipping estimator. Do not submit an order, payment, login, account creation or a real street address; do not bypass bot challenges or access controls. Do not commit cart/session/cookie details. The initial Pucks/CoffeeMan quotes have already been established; reuse the recorded evidence through the generalized policy workflow above. Keep the public Worker deterministic; this browser is a research/development tool, not an LLM dependency in the runtime.
5. **Judge the page visually.** Open the current production page and revised desktop/mobile pages in Chrome, capture before/after screenshots, and actually inspect their image content through a supported image/read tool. Use viewport or section screenshots at readable resolution instead of shrinking an entire long page until the text is illegible. If image input is not working in the available tools, report that concrete limitation rather than claiming visual review. Review hierarchy, whitespace, density, duplicate labels and how easily a shopper finds shipping and a total. A passing DOM checklist alone is insufficient.
6. **Fix concrete observed UX defects.** The overseer's render of main at b75e296 (recorded fixtures, not a new live source observation) had a 2289 px comparison table inside a 1325 px container at 1440 px desktop width: "Delivered total" began at x=1641, offscreen. The per-kilogram winner described a four-by-250 g multipack as "1 × 250 g"; fix all pack/quantity labels so multipack contents and purchased grams are accurate. These are examples to verify and improve, not a prescribed implementation.
7. **Validate meaningful outcomes and checkpoint useful progress.** Update browser QA to check the redesigned shopping behavior instead of requiring every old diagnostic label to remain permanently visible. Preserve shipping math, honest unknowns, quantity/pack rounding, stock, scheduled refreshes and storage. Run npm run verify and relevant browser QA after substantive changes, then record concise results, screenshot review findings and shipping research evidence in docs/STATUS.md. ## Latest owner correction — remove the coffee-variant feature (2026-10-12)

The owner explicitly asks: "Get rid of the coffee variant. There's only two variants and it's the same coffee." This latest instruction supersedes every older variant-separation/selector requirement in this prompt, AGENTS.md and the design/architecture/status documentation. - Remove the blend/variant selector, unobserved-variant menu entries, variant warnings, "other variant" counts/links and variant-as-a-shopping-configuration from the home and product page. Do not replace it with another blend toggle or add variant-specific product cards.

Include the currently "Variant not stated" Coffee4U listing in that same comparison instead of hiding it behind a selector or withholding it as another blend. Offers can still be unavailable/unrankable for genuine stock, freshness, shipping or cart-scope reasons.
- Keep single packs, four-packs and eight-packs as distinct offers with correct whole-pack rounding, purchased grams, item prices, shipping conditions and totals. Removing the variant feature does not merge or duplicate SKUs, pack sizes, cart discounts or service-specific policies.
- Retain original vendor product wording and any raw listing identity metadata in evidence/optional offer details if useful. Do not invent a manufacturer blend or relabel an unstated listing as Classico to make it eligible. Raw wording is provenance, not a default ranking filter or repeated variant badge.
- Remove implicit variant filtering from the default API/quote flow, not just its visible widget. Old shared URLs containing variant=classico/unspecified/etc must still preserve product/quantity/locality but resolve to this unified comparison; discard or ignore the obsolete variant parameter without creating a second view.
- Update AGENTS.md, catalog/public API where appropriate, docs and browser QA so they no longer instruct variant separation. Verify that the single product comparison can include Coffee4U alongside the other Crema e Gusto listings, still names vendors correctly, calculates packs/shipping honestly and has no residual blend control/warning. Existing stock, policy-scope, unknown-shipping and retired-product safeguards remain mandatory.

The active catalog remains Lavazza Crema e Gusto vacuum-packed ground coffee only; Oro, Rossa, Suerte and other product lines stay excluded. The home is still the product index with one real card. Keep the Canton Zürich design system, Inter and established semantic palette. Shurik writes the code/tests; the overseer only steers and reviews.

## Overseer review follow-up — bind cart evidence to its actual scope, then finish shopping readability (2026-10-13)

This is review feedback under the existing owner shipping/UX brief, not a change to the one-product/no-blend correction above. Address the evidence-scope defect first in the next fresh iteration. Shurik implements the changes and tests; the overseer edits only this brief.

- **Do not infer a monotone CoffeeMan threshold from sampled carts.** The 3-82 policy makes every eligible single/4-pack cart at or above ₪231 free, with no cart-size cap. The vendor publishes no such threshold. Observing free courier for 7 singles (₪231), 8 singles (₪264 before the 10% promotion / ₪237.60 after it), and two 4-packs (₪248) does not establish free delivery for every larger or otherwise unobserved cart. Calling this inference "conservative" does not prove it. Preserve the correct, explicitly conditional results for those observed cart configurations, and the separate one-eight-pack ₪20 quote; represent the free observations with validated SKU/pack count, whole-pack quantity, item-subtotal/discount, named-method, destination-evidence and review scope. Outside the verified scope, retain the published base fee or explicit unresolved condition instead of inventing zero shipping. A general threshold is acceptable only with a new published rule or browser evidence that actually supports the stated range and limits. Do not add unrelated products or infer a universal CoffeeMan rule.
- Verify that the saved cart examples still reproduce their recorded fees, while an unobserved larger cart (for example 3 kg of singles or three 4-packs) cannot inherit free delivery merely because its subtotal exceeds ₪231. Check expired/conflicting evidence and price/promotion changes too. Keep read-time enrichment honest: no price/stock/observedAt/lastRefreshAt advance, no stretching the eight-pack quote, and no merging distinct packs/SKUs.

However, those common evidence records still carry `service: null` despite a successful step selecting door-to-door delivery. Record the actual confirmed method in the reusable evidence schema and preserve method/quantity/destination restrictions through policy interpretation and public quote output. Retain exact public-flow blockers when a required field or quote genuinely cannot be obtained; an extractor failure is not a vendor restriction.

Make the one-card index concise and the selected locality readable. Preserve the dedicated/shareable product route, quantity/locality state, all eligible Crema e Gusto listings, native keyboard disclosures and necessary stock/failure/conditional/stale warnings.

Cover both 500 g and the 2 kg CoffeeMan winner on mobile (including the real last-check-failed state), with the actual vendor, accurate purchased packs/grams, item subtotal, named shipping method/charge and delivered total visible in the first 390×844 viewport. Save desktop/home views too. If the pinned PNG reader still rejects images, say so; DOM geometry and pixel maps are not native image inspection. Do not relaunch identical quote probes as a substitute for the scope/UI implementation.

CoffeeMan's production Worker requests returned HTTP 403 at the 00:17 cron while runner requests succeeded. Keep last-known-good observations and visible failure warnings; do not bypass vendor controls or administer Cloudflare. The next scheduled production retry is 06:17 UTC, so work on the scoped evidence and shopping UI rather than claiming a separate retry at the backoff-due timestamp.

## Current owner priorities — product index, reusable shipping knowledge, progressive disclosure (2026-10-12)

The owner has reviewed the updated website and still finds it very cluttered. The home page must become an overview index of products, with the comparison workflow on a dedicated product page. The owner also expects obvious browser-visible shipping rules, such as Pucks free shipping above ₪100, to be found systematically and actually used by the site. These priorities replace the earlier instruction to repeat the initial shipping investigation first in every fresh iteration. The first Pucks/CoffeeMan/Coffee4U browser investigation is already evidenced in iterations 3-67 through 3-72. Use that evidence; fresh browser work should address a specific missing, contradictory or stale condition. Do not spend whole iterations reproducing unchanged amounts while the requested product/UI work waits.

Shurik implements all code, assets, tests and documentation. The overseer only changes this brief and reviews results. Keep the Canton Zürich design direction, Inter, palette and Crema e Gusto-only active scope below.

### 1. Make the home page a product overview index

- The canonical home route must show a clean product index, not the full vendor comparison board. Render its cards from the active catalog. Today that means **one real card: Lavazza Crema e Gusto vacuum-packed ground coffee**. Design the structure to support additional products later, but do not add or reactivate Oro, Rossa, Suerte, other product lines, fabricated offerings or placeholder cards. Crema e Gusto offers share one comparison; pack sizes and multipacks remain distinct.
- Each product card links to a real, directly loadable product-detail URL. The home page needs only product identity, a concise useful summary and a clear way to open the comparison. If a summary price is shown, its quantity, destination, freshness and conditional nature must be understandable; do not mix different cart sizes into a misleading "from" price.

Preserve shareable selection state and handle existing product/query links, including retired-line fallbacks, without losing quantity or locality; obsolete variant parameters are ignored. - Introduce a common, validated shipping-evidence/policy representation and evaluator used by every adapter/quote: distinguish published rules, observed conditional cart quotes and unknown/inconsistent rules. Preserve service, eligible product/SKU/pack, quantity or weight/subtotal scope, destination scope, currency, amount or threshold rule, source, observed/review time and certainty. Per-vendor recipes may differ; common policy interpretation, arithmetic, evidence storage and validation should be shared. Do not keep accumulating unrelated hard-coded adapter strings as the only shipping model.
- Pucks is the concrete acceptance case: the rendered estimator established **₪30 home delivery and free shipping above the stated ₪100 item subtotal**, including 2 × 250 g = ₪60 + ₪30 = ₪90 and 4 × 250 g = ₪120 with free delivery to Tel Aviv / 6100000. Apply the rule to eligible current offers and show the free-shipping condition in the appropriate delivery details. Preserve the threshold comparison/exclusions actually established by the vendor; do not silently turn "above" into "at least" without checking the boundary semantics. Coverage remains qualified beyond the destinations tested.
- CoffeeMan demonstrates why a single global threshold is insufficient: the ₪240 eight-pack cart still charged ₪20 while some single-pack/two-four-pack carts showed free shipping; the small single/four-pack carts showed a ₪15 distribution-center alternative. Store conditional evidence at its actual scope, and keep unverified rules unresolved. Do not infer a nationwide/free-over-X rule from one cart or flatten SKU/pack distinctions. - **Fix the known-knowledge/old-store gap.** The latest recorded production probes still had old shipping unknowns even after the policies were established and deployed. Implement a safe versioned policy resolution/enrichment or migration so newly validated shipping knowledge can apply to matching persisted offers promptly, without waiting hours for the next item refresh. Choose the mechanism within the existing Worker architecture; keep it deterministic, bounded and compatible with stored data. Preserve the item's actual price/stock observation time and shipping evidence's own time; applying a newer shipping rule must not claim a fresh vendor price/stock check or advance lastRefreshAt. Do not fabricate an item price, force a Cloudflare refresh through admin tools, or turn a policy into an unconditional coverage guarantee. Test an old persisted Pucks offer with unknown shipping gaining the evidenced rule after a policy update.
- The public Worker must continue to work without the coding loop or a browser open. It should consume validated policy data and bounded public sources; browser research is development/research tooling, not an LLM/browser session triggered by visitor traffic. Document how policy evidence is rechecked or becomes stale, and keep unresolved shipping explicit.

### 3. Use substantial progressive disclosure on the product page

The goal is a short decision flow, not merely smaller versions of every existing paragraph.

- Default view: compact product identity/selection, an easy quantity and locality change, and the best eligible offer with vendor, accurate purchased pack/grams, item subtotal, **named delivery method and charge**, delivered total, stock and a short necessary conditional/unknown/stale warning. On 390 × 844, the actual money values and method must be visible in the initial viewport; a card whose top edge begins at y=829 does not satisfy this. Achieve this by prioritizing content, not tiny text or hiding essential uncertainty.
- Use a clear "Compare other offers" disclosure or a compact comparison preview. The Coffee4U listing belongs in the same Crema e Gusto comparison; retain its original vendor wording in evidence without a separate blend choice. Keep relevant controls accessible, with secondary configuration in a clearly labelled section/drawer when useful.
- Delivery alternatives, pickup locations/fees, free-shipping conditions, detailed coverage and terms belong under "Delivery options" / "Offer details". Self-pickup stays separate from delivered ranking and should be collapsed by default rather than three always-expanded repeated rows. Show a brief coverage qualification beside a conditional total, with the full prose inside details.
- Price history, parser/source provenance, FX, refresh diagnostics and detailed timestamps are secondary disclosures. Retain concise visible stale/failure/unknown warnings when they change a shopping decision. Hide empty "missing information" sections and remove repeated teaching copy, duplicate headings, repeated product restrictions and the same caveat printed several times.
- Use the Canton Zürich native disclosure/accordion/service patterns and the selected blue/soft-blue scheme. Keep semantic stock/uncertainty colors and text labels, keyboard/focus behavior, RTL handling and readable type. Opening one useful detail must not require reading through unrelated diagnostics.
- Fix the independently observed pickup-name regression: the saved after-1440/after-390 screenshots and passing QA output contained **"[object HTMLSpanElement]"** instead of the vendor. Shurik fixes the node/text handling and adds a meaningful rendered check for the actual vendor names and the absence of object-string artifacts.

The production Worker name is attention-shoppers; main pushes are intended to auto-deploy through Cloudflare Workers Builds. Shurik has no Cloudflare credentials, API access or deployment tools. All development and integration validation must work locally. Read AGENTS.md and the design/architecture docs.

## Required shopping behavior

1. Discover and validate several actual vendor listings. Use public vendor APIs or public product pages and permitted structured data. Record source URLs, retrieval dates and what each source establishes. Prefer vendors serving Israel; international vendors qualify only when delivery to Israel is evidenced.
2. Match the actual product: Lavazza, Crema e Gusto, ground coffee in a vacuum brick. Record grams, pack count and original vendor wording. Do not confuse beans, capsules, pods or similarly named products. There is no shopper-facing blend/variant feature; the owner's latest correction requires one Crema e Gusto comparison. A typical 250 g pack is a starting hypothesis, not a verified fact for every listing.
3. Let shoppers choose a sensible quantity and Israeli delivery locality/postcode. Do not collect or store a street address. Different pack sizes and multipacks should normalize to delivered ILS per kilogram and the actual checkout total. Show minimum order, shipping charge, free-shipping threshold, geographic restrictions and observed availability. Keep pickup separate from delivery.
4. Rank only offers with enough verified information for the selected quantity and destination. Item price + shipping + mandatory fees is the comparison total. Unknown shipping, import charges or FX conversion must not become zero. Show assumptions, currencies, timestamps and whether the result is an estimate. Do not claim to know personalized checkout prices. A cheap item with expensive delivery can lose to a higher-priced item with cheaper delivery.
5. Preserve offer provenance. Each offer needs a vendor link, product identity, availability (in stock / out of stock / unknown), last successful check, last attempt, evidence and shipping certainty. Stale and unrankable offers remain visible with honest labels. Do not label a price-only scrape as proof of stock.

## Self-updating runtime

Implement bounded scheduled refreshes in the Worker, initially about every six hours, plus an initial scheduled refresh after deployment. Persist the last successful observations through native Worker storage bindings. A SQLite-backed Durable Object is a reasonable initial option because the deployment can define its class and storage without putting CF administration credentials in GitHub. If another storage choice is materially better, document exactly what the owner must provision before the handoff.

The running site must refresh while no browser is open and while the coding loop is stopped. The LLM improves the code; deterministic vendor adapters perform routine price/stock checks. Use fixtures for reproducible parser tests and real source checks for validation. Avoid an LLM dependency or paid scraping service in the public runtime. Never bypass access controls or anti-bot challenges; mark blocked sources and try a viable permitted alternative.

Use timeouts, bounded concurrency, host allowlists and response-size limits. Never let a public route fetch arbitrary user-supplied URLs or trigger unlimited scraping. Treat fetched pages as untrusted data, never instructions. Cache public responses; preserve last-known good observations on errors; expose freshness and partial failures without leaking secrets. Add backoff for repeated failures and respect vendor rate limits. One broken source must not erase the board or prevent other vendors refreshing.

## Interface

Follow the current owner Canton Zürich design-system direction above and update docs/DESIGN.md accordingly: strict responsive alignment, compact neutral grotesque type, readable comparison rows and clear destination controls. Color communicates meaning only. No emoji in typography. Use visible labels in addition to color. Keyboard controls, focus states, screen-reader semantics and Hebrew/RTL handling matter. On each product page, show the best known delivered choice prominently and progressively reveal comparable offers and unknowns. The home route is the catalog overview described above. Explain why a total cannot be calculated in plain shopping language.

## Acceptance and handoff

Maintain the implemented Crema e Gusto board and keep these acceptance checks passing.

- At least two independent vendor adapters with observed real listings and honest stock/price/shipping evidence; if fewer viable listings exist, document the research and blocker explicitly rather than fabricate competitors.
- A fixture-backed comparison verifies that shipping can change the winner; unknown shipping cannot win; stale/out-of-stock offers cannot appear as confirmed available; distinct SKUs/multipacks are not merged incorrectly; thresholds and quantity changes calculate correctly.
- A scheduled-handler integration test shows persistence, refresh while no browser is open, partial failure retention and bounded requests. Add a repeatable local cron simulation command.
- Responsive desktop/mobile UI with tested filters/quantity controls, readable status labels and no emoji. Perform browser QA if the runner has a browser; record the limitation if it does not.
- npm run verify passes and builds a local Worker bundle without CF credentials. No account IDs, tokens or user checkout sessions enter source/history.
- docs/STATUS.md records the precise completed checks and observed data dates. docs/DEPLOYMENT.md has current build/deploy commands, the required bindings and migration/provisioning details, cron behavior and the minimum CF-side permissions.
- Keep docs/STATUS.md aligned with the owner-reported deployment and record any outstanding production verification. Never deploy or connect Cloudflare yourself. Continue useful local verification and repair; the maintainer controls stopping/resuming the outer Shurik loop.

Keep progress across iterations using repository docs and Shurik's history tools. Choose the next small, useful task, verify it, and leave a clear next step. Avoid rewriting working components just to change frameworks.

## Iteration 3-83 — Pucks destination coverage extended to every selectable locality; same-rule policy updates refresh persisted provenance at read time (2026-10-13)

**The gap.** The checked-in Pucks policy v1 had sampled Tel Aviv / 6100000, Eilat / 8800000 and
Jerusalem / 9100000 only, while the site offers Haifa / 3100000 and Be’er Sheva / 8400000 as
destinations with no estimator evidence behind them. The coverage caveat said only "Tel Aviv and
Eilat carts". Separately, the read-time evaluator filled *unknown* shipping from a validated policy but
left an already-stamped row's **evidence** untouched, so after a same-rule policy update (newer
coverage evidence, new retrieval time) the board kept serving the older caveat and the older policy
version until the next 6-hour vendor refresh — a provenance version of the known-knowledge gap.

**What changed (research + implementation).**

- Three bounded recipe runs through the real Chrome/ChromeDriver workflow
  (`npm run research:browser -- recipe pucks`) with the destination step verified on the page:
  a 2 × 250 g cart to Haifa / 3100000 and a 2 × 250 g cart to Be’er Sheva / 8400000 each showed
  **₪60 + ₪30 = ₪90**, and a 4 × 250 g cart to Haifa showed **₪120 + ₪0 = ₪120** (the free-over-₪100
  rule reproduced at a third locality). No order, payment, login, account or street address was
  involved and no bot challenge was bypassed; cart/session identifiers are stripped from the records.
  Evidence: `docs/evidence/browser-research/2026-10-13-pucks-haifa-500g.json`,
  `docs/evidence/browser-research/2026-10-13-pucks-beersheva-500g.json`,
  `docs/evidence/browser-research/2026-10-13-pucks-haifa-1kg.json` and the summary
  `docs/evidence/browser-research/2026-10-13-pucks-destination-extension.json`.
- `pucks-il-home-delivery` is now **v2**: the ₪30 / free-above-₪100 rule and its strict `above`
  semantics are unchanged, the coverage caveat names all five selectable localities with a postcode,
  and the evidence note/time record the 2026-10-13 re-check. The adapter derives its parsed row from
  the policy, so a fresh parse carries v2 directly.
- `enrichObservationShipping()` now distinguishes "fill missing fields" from "refresh stale
  provenance": when a row already carries a `shipping.policy` stamp for the **same policy id with an
  older version** and the money/scope is identical (amount, threshold, semantics, origin, min order,
  max grams and alternatives all equal), the evaluator refreshes only the policy stamp, the coverage
  caveat and evidence that came from this policy (same evidence URL). A version that changes any
  amount leaves the row untouched for the next vendor refresh — a parsed rate is never overwritten at
  read time. The item's `observedAt`, price and stock, and the refresh completion marker, stay
  untouched.

**Verified locally (2026-10-13 UTC):**

- `npm run verify` — **157/157** `node:test` cases pass (two new: a same-rule policy update refreshes
  a v1-stamped row's caveat/evidence/policy stamp at read time while the ₪30 rate and the item
  observation time stay, and a hypothetical v3 that changes the amount does not overwrite a known
  parsed row). `wrangler deploy --dry-run` builds the bundle (127.74 KiB / gzip 31.50 KiB; bindings
  `BOARD` + `ASSETS`).
- **Live local end-to-end:** a fresh `wrangler dev` store parsed its Pucks row at 01:35:05.993Z with
  the v1 stamp. After the v2 policy was loaded, `/api/board?grams=500&dest=haifa` served the row with
  policy **v2**, the five-locality caveat, the refreshed evidence time 2026-10-13T01:41:10Z and the
  unchanged ₪30 rate — with `observedAt` still 01:35:05.993Z and no `lastRefreshAt` change. The
  rendered details read "Shipping rule: pucks-il-home-delivery v2 (observed anonymous cart quote,
  observed 13 Oct 2026, 04:41 …)" and "Shipping evidence refreshed from validated policy
  pucks-il-home-delivery v2 … the rate and its quantity scope are unchanged." Evidence:
  `docs/evidence/local-provenance-refresh-20261013T0149Z.json`.
- `npm run qa:browser` (offline fixtures) — **90/90** checks, zero console errors.
  `npm run qa:browser -- http://127.0.0.1:8789` against the fresh live Worker — **86/86**, zero
  console errors; `npm run qa:browser -- https://attention-shoppers.igormaka.workers.dev` against the
  deployed build — **87/87**, zero console errors (home→product flow, unified comparison, named
  vendors and money values from the live store). Evidence:
  `docs/evidence/browser-qa-production-20261013T0154Z.json`.
- `npm run cron:offline` — 6 bounded requests, all three vendors saved (five observations), no
  failures; the scheduled path is unaffected.
- `npm run check:sources` (live, 01:50 UTC) — all five listings pass with unchanged prices and stock
  (CoffeeMan ₪33/₪124/₪240, Pucks ₪30, Coffee4U ₪38, all `in_stock`); the freshly parsed Pucks row
  carries the v2 coverage caveat and evidence note. Evidence:
  `docs/evidence/source-check-20261013T0150Z.json`.
- `npm run probe:production` (read-only public GETs, 01:35 UTC) — **25/25** checks against
  `https://attention-shoppers.igormaka.workers.dev`: five ranked offers, no retired row, the obsolete
  `?variant=` URL resolving to the same unified board, all four policies current, CoffeeMan's next
  attempt still the 06:17 UTC tick (the 00:17 tick's egress block remains). Evidence:
  `docs/evidence/production-probe-20261013T0135Z.json`.
- The probe gained a **policy-version check**: every ranked offer whose rule still matches the current
  validated policy must serve the current version (the read-time provenance refresh guarantees it),
  while a changed rule may wait for the next vendor refresh. Re-run at 01:56 UTC — **26/26** checks
  pass. Evidence: `docs/evidence/production-probe-20261013T0156Z.json`.

Iteration 3-81 removes the last variant coupling from the data layer: a stored offer's identity key no
longer contains the blend wording a listing prints, legacy blend-keyed rows are collapsed at read time
with their stable-key replacement (newest observation wins), and failure markers plus previous-check

## Iteration 3-85 — CoffeeMan free evidence bound to its observed carts; Coffee4U method recorded; index and locality readability (2026-10-13)

**The defect.** Iteration 3-82 promoted CoffeeMan's free-delivery observation as a monotone threshold
(`₪231, at_least`), so any single/4-pack cart at or above ₪231 would be free. The vendor publishes no such
threshold and the sampled carts are not monotone (a ₪198 cart paid ₪25, the ₪240 8-pack SKU cart paid
₪20, while the ₪231/₪264/₪248 carts were free), so a 3 kg single-pack cart or three 4-packs could inherit
free delivery merely from a subtotal. The same review found the Coffee4U destination-extension evidence
records carried `service: null` even though the runs had successfully selected door-to-door delivery, and
that the home index card still repeated a long comparison explanation while the 390 px locality control
clipped the selected locality inside a half-width column.

**What changed (evidence scope first).**

- `coffeeman-single-4pack-il-home-delivery` is now **v3**. `rule.freeThreshold` is removed; the free
  observations live in `rule.freeCartConditions`, one entry per observed free cart with validated listing
  prefix + SKU, pack count, whole-pack units, ordered grams, item subtotal before any discount, paid item
  total, the named method, destination evidence, observation time and its own evidence note: `singles-7`
  (SKU 930333, 7 units, ₪231), `singles-8` (8 units, ₪264 before the automatic 10% promotion → ₪237.60)
  and `fourpack-2` (SKU 930334, 2 units, ₪248). No threshold is recorded. `supersedes` names the exact
  superseded v2 threshold (₪231, `at_least`, `observed_cart`) so a persisted row stamped by v2 stops
  applying it at read time — the published ₪25 base amount, the item price, stock and `observedAt` are
  untouched — and a rule that changes any amount is still never swapped in at read time.
- The quote engine matches a cart against each condition exactly (listing prefix, SKU, service, pack
  count, units, ordered grams and the pre-discount subtotal, falling back to the paid total when no
  discount applies). A matched cart becomes free with a label naming the exact observed cart; an
  unmatched cart keeps the published ₪25, and when its subtotal is at or above an observed free subtotal
  the card says free delivery was observed only on specific carts. `base.shipping` exposes
  `freeCartConditions`/`freeCondition`; `policySummary()` exposes the condition ids/SKUs/subtotals.
- The CoffeeMan adapter derives its free conditions from the policy (never a hard-coded threshold), and
  the 8-pack SKU policy is unchanged: it keeps its own ₪20 quote and never inherits the conditions.
- **Coffee4U method evidence.** Recipe method steps now declare `confirmsService`; a successful run
  records `service` + `serviceConfirmed: true`, and an optional method step that could not be confirmed
  records `service: null` + `serviceConfirmed: false` plus a qualification (schema validation rejects
  both a claimed-but-unnamed method and an undisclosed unconfirmed one). The nine checked-in Pucks and
  Coffee4U quote records were backfilled from their recorded successful method step with a note saying
  so, and `coffee4u-il-home-delivery` names the method in `observedFor.method`; the public quote output
  keeps `shipping.service`/`serviceLabel` and the quantity/destination restrictions (`maxTotalGrams`,
  closed-locality-list caveat, alternatives) unchanged.
- **Readability.** The home index card is one compact line (`3 vendors · 5 listings: …`) instead of the
  comparison walkthrough, and the catalog intro is one sentence. On ≤720 px the locality group takes the
  full row and the option text drops the redundant “area” suffix, so `Tel Aviv–Yafo · 6100000` is fully
  readable at 390 px (measured width 343 px, label one line).

**Verified locally (2026-10-13 UTC).**

- `npm run verify` — **161/161** `node:test` cases (new/updated: the scoped-condition policy validation,
  exact-cart matching, the v2→v3 read-time migration, the 3 kg/three-4-pack/repriced carts keeping ₪25,
  the expired-policy fallback, and the confirmed/unconfirmed service schema), plus
  `wrangler deploy --dry-run` (bundle builds; bindings `BOARD` + `ASSETS`).
- `npm run evidence:coffeeman-scope` — every observed cart reproduces its recorded fee
  (₪25/₪25/₪25/₪0/₪0/₪25/₪0/₪20) and every unobserved cart keeps ₪25; evidence rewritten at
  `docs/evidence/coffeeman-free-condition-20261013.json` with `reproduced: true`.
- `npm run qa:browser` (offline fixtures) — **94/94** checks, zero console errors. New checks cover the
  exact free condition on the 2 kg card, the 3 kg cart keeping the base rate, the concise home card, the
  full-width readable locality control, and the 2 kg / 500 g CoffeeMan cards with the real
  last-check-failed state. Screenshots and DOM geometry:
  `docs/evidence/visual-review/2026-10-13-coffeeman-scope-and-readability-review.json`,
  `docs/evidence/browser-qa-fixtures-20261013T0240Z.json`.
- `scripts/probe-production.mjs` gained read-only checks for the scoped conditions: the 2 kg single-pack

  once the deployed build serves the new fields, so the probe stays green while the main-push build rolls

- PNG limitation (unchanged): the pinned file-read tool rejects image input, so the saved screenshots

rows stop applying the ₪231 threshold and gain the exact conditions as soon as this build is live, without
a vendor refresh and without advancing `lastRefreshAt`. The 06:17 UTC cron tick remains the next actual

and the evidence note/time record the 2026-10-13 re-check. The adapter derives its parsed row from
  the policy, so a fresh parse carries v2 directly.
- `enrichObservationShipping()` now distinguishes "fill missing fields" from "refresh stale
  provenance": when a row already carries a `shipping.policy` stamp for the **same policy id with an
  older version** and the money/scope is identical (amount, threshold, semantics, origin, min order,
  max grams and alternatives all equal), the evaluator refreshes only the policy stamp, the coverage
  caveat and evidence that came from this policy (same evidence URL). A version that changes any
  amount leaves the row untouched for the next vendor refresh — a parsed rate is never overwritten at
  read time. The item's `observedAt`, price and stock, and the refresh completion marker, stay
  untouched.

**Verified locally (2026-10-13 UTC):**

- `npm run verify` — **157/157** `node:test` cases pass (two new: a same-rule policy update refreshes
  a v1-stamped row's caveat/evidence/policy stamp at read time while the ₪30 rate and the item
  observation time stay, and a hypothetical v3 that changes the amount does not overwrite a known
  parsed row). `wrangler deploy --dry-run` builds the bundle (127.74 KiB / gzip 31.50 KiB; bindings
  `BOARD` + `ASSETS`).
- **Live local end-to-end:** a fresh `wrangler dev` store parsed its Pucks row at 01:35:05.993Z with
  the v1 stamp. After the v2 policy was loaded, `/api/board?grams=500&dest=haifa` served the row with
  policy **v2**, the five-locality caveat, the refreshed evidence time 2026-10-13T01:41:10Z and the
  unchanged ₪30 rate — with `observedAt` still 01:35:05.993Z and no `lastRefreshAt` change. The
  rendered details read "Shipping rule: pucks-il-home-delivery v2 (observed anonymous cart quote,
  observed 13 Oct 2026, 04:41 …)" and "Shipping evidence refreshed from validated policy
  pucks-il-home-delivery v2 … the rate and its quantity scope are unchanged." Evidence:
  `docs/evidence/local-provenance-refresh-20261013T0149Z.json`.
- `npm run qa:browser` (offline fixtures) — **90/90** checks, zero console errors.
  `npm run qa:browser -- http://127.0.0.1:8789` against the fresh live Worker — **86/86**, zero

  `docs/evidence/browser-qa-production-20261013T0154Z.json`.
- `npm run cron:offline` — 6 bounded requests, all three vendors saved (five observations), no

- `npm run check:sources` (live, 01:50 UTC) — all five listings pass with unchanged prices and stock

  `docs/evidence/source-check-20261013T0150Z.json`.

  `https://attention-shoppers.igormaka.workers.dev`: five ranked offers, no retired row, the obsolete
